$comment: Reviewed migrations that are permitted to exist in a deployable tree.
assertReviewedMigrations blocks any migration directory present in the
release that is not listed here, and any entry listed here that is not
present in the release. Adding a migration therefore BLOCKS deployment
until a human adds it to this file, which is the review point.
Each entry must be reviewed for: generated SQL, backward compatibility with
the currently deployed application (expand/contract), a rollback, and a
Migrations are applied by an operator with `prisma migrate deploy` from a
controlled environment, never by this pipeline. Listing a migration here
permits the CODE to deploy; it does not apply the migration.
